criteria.reason: 明确说明智能体是控制机器人移动、抓取和放置的决策程序。
criteria.evidence_quote: The agent is the robot control software deciding where to drive and how to pick and place.

criteria.reason: 环境包含货架、货物、订单队列、障碍物、工人和机器人动力学。
criteria.evidence_quote: The world contains shelves, stock, order queues, obstacles, workers and robot dynamics.

criteria.reason: 状态输入包含位置、目标货物、夹爪状态、局部地图、订单进度和安全观测。
criteria.evidence_quote: Its decision input includes pose, target item, gripper status, a local map, order progress and safety observations.

criteria.reason: 动作包括移动、转向、抓取、放置、等待和路径选择。
criteria.evidence_quote: Available controls include moving, turning, picking, placing, waiting and choosing a route.

criteria.reason: 奖励鼓励正确订单、安全无碰撞、高效行驶，而非仅速度。
criteria.evidence_quote: Reward successful correct orders, safe collision-free operation and efficient travel, not speed alone.

criteria.reason: 终止条件包括完成、超时、严重碰撞或电量耗尽。
criteria.evidence_quote: End a run on completion, timeout, serious collision or exhausted battery.

criteria.reason: 指出遮挡的人和缺失未完成订单信息会使观测不满足马尔可夫性。
criteria.evidence_quote: Occluded people and missing unfinished-order information can make the observation insufficiently Markov.

criteria.reason: 评估指标包括成功率、时间、碰撞、行驶距离和陌生布局表现。
criteria.evidence_quote: Measure success, time, collisions, travel distance and performance on unfamiliar layouts.
